compiled:
📰 General

Off-Duty Pilot Faces No Prison Time After Attempting to Disable Flight Engines •

A former Alaska Airlines pilot, Daniel Sheldon, will not face prison time following his attempt to tamper with the engines of a passenger flight in 2023. U.S. District Judge Peter Butner dismissed the federal charges against Sheldon, citing a lack of evidence demonstrating intent to endanger the aircraft. The judge noted that Sheldon’s actions appeared to be a misguided attempt at a distress call. Sheldon will instead be sentenced to probation and must undergo mental health evaluations.

🌍 World

Turkish Tanker Aboard by Drone Attack in Ukraine’s Odesa Region •

A Turkish-flagged tanker was struck by a drone in the Odesa region of southern Ukraine on Monday, resulting in a fire. Ukrainian officials confirmed the incident, attributing it to Russian forces, though Russia has not yet officially claimed responsibility. The attack occurred amidst ongoing tensions and military operations in the region. The tanker was carrying a cargo of oil at the time of the incident, and firefighting efforts are currently underway.

🦅 US

Judge Rules Government Missteps in Comey Case Could Lead to Dismissal •

A federal judge in Virginia ruled that the Department of Justice’s handling of the criminal case against former FBI Director James Comey contains “genuine issues of misconduct.” The judge ordered prosecutors to produce grand jury materials, citing concerns about the government’s actions. This ruling suggests the evidence presented may be insufficient to proceed with the charges. The decision raises questions about the integrity of the investigation and its potential impact on the case’s future.

💰 Business

Democratic Senators Propose $200 Monthly Boost to Social Security Benefits •

A group of Democratic senators are advocating for a $200 monthly increase in Social Security benefits through the Social Security Emergency Inflation Relief Act. The proposed legislation aims to provide immediate relief to recipients facing rising inflation. Eligibility criteria for the increase are currently being determined, but the proposal suggests a targeted approach to those most vulnerable. The legislation is awaiting consideration in the Senate, with details regarding specific income thresholds yet to be finalized.

💻 Technology

Black Friday TV Deals Surge: Samsung, LG, and TCL Offer Significant Savings •

Retailers are offering substantial discounts on televisions during the Black Friday shopping period. Several major brands, including Samsung, LG, and TCL, are presenting notable price reductions on a range of television models. These deals primarily focus on last year’s models to reduce existing inventory, with some newer models also included in the promotions. Consumers are advised to compare prices and check retailer websites for the most up-to-date offers.

🎭 Entertainment

Moana’s Epic Journey Returns: Stunning Live-Action Teaser Unveiled •

Disney released a teaser trailer for its upcoming live-action adaptation of Moana, showcasing the film’s breathtaking visuals. The trailer focuses on Catherine Lagaʻaia’s performance of “I Am Gia,” highlighting the connection between the character and the ocean. The clip emphasizes the dramatic sky-meets-sea imagery central to the story. The teaser premiered on Monday, generating excitement for the film’s release.

🏅 Sports

Bowles Blames Punt Decision for Bills' Game-Sealing Touchdown •

Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles admitted a punt decision proved detrimental to his team’s chances against the Buffalo Bills. Facing fourth-and-2 with a late deficit, analytics recommended going for the first down, but Bowles opted for a punt. The Bills subsequently capitalized on the punt, driving for a game-sealing touchdown. The Buccaneers ultimately lost the game 37-32.

🔬 Science

Scientists Discover Genes Utilize Physics to Orchestrate Complex Growth Processes •

Researchers have identified how genes employ physical principles, specifically mechanical forces, to guide the development of living organisms. The study reveals that genes don’t just dictate what a creature should be, but actively shape its form through interactions with the surrounding environment. Scientists created a novel thermometer capable of measuring “quantumness,” detecting quantum entanglement without causing its collapse. This breakthrough offers a new tool for understanding the fundamental nature of quantum mechanics and its relationship to the macroscopic world.

🩺 Health

First Human Infection with H5N5 Bird Flu Confirmed in Washington State •

Health officials in Washington State have identified the first-ever instance of a human contracting H5N5 avian influenza. The resident experienced a significant illness attributed to the highly pathogenic virus. This marks the first documented case of the H5N5 strain directly transmitted to a person. Researchers are investigating the source of the infection and the individual’s specific symptoms. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is monitoring the situation closely.
